intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in New Albany for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 4 of them free. The magic runs from November 28 (Light Up New Albany) through December 19 (Georgetown Last Minute Gift Show), with the Holiday Open House at Culbertson Mansion (December 5), the Gingerbread Extraveganza (December 12) and the Polar Express Party at Floyd County Library (December 17) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
